Theorem
[Uniqueness on $\mathbb R^n$ under exponential quadratic growth] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0169 1. ch12:12.3\group Weak Scalar Maximum Principles

Let $u_1,u_2\in C^{2,1}(\mathbb R^n\times (0,T])\cap C^0(\mathbb R^n\times [0,T])$ solve the heat equation and satisfy $|u_i(x,t)|\leq Ae^{B|x|^2}$. If $u_1(\cdot ,0)=u_2(\cdot ,0)$, then $u_1=u_2$ on $\mathbb R^n\times [0,T]$.

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:euclidean-heat-wmp-exponential-quadratic-growth Apply Theorem 1.1 to $u_1-u_2$ and to $u_2-u_1$.

□
